info.title: Striart Control Protocol
info.description:
Human control plane of Striart: read the orchestrator state, follow its changes, and act as the human in the loop (launch, merge, sync, stop, promote, rollback, resolve, arbitrate permissions, release the main session, reconcile).

JSON-RPC 2.0, named parameters. Transports: stdio (`striart api --stdio`, NDJSON or Content-Length framing — for IDE extensions, no network surface) and HTTP loopback (`striart dashboard`: POST /rpc + GET /events Server-Sent Events, sign-in link + HttpOnly session cookie, Host/Origin/X-Striart checks).

Every result is a Striart Document ({schemaVersion, command, ok, outcome, data, warnings}); every error carries the same Document in `error.data` (code/kind/message/hint/details) — the shapes of `striart <command> --json`.

The agent plane (MCP) never exposes permission arbitration, ticket closing nor lock release: they exist only here.

framing.ndjson: One JSON-RPC message per line (UTF-8, LF). 1 MiB per message at most.
framing.content-length: LSP-style "Content-Length: <bytes>\r\n\r\n<json>" frames (vscode-jsonrpc, lsp4j). 1 MiB per message at most.

endpoints.GET /auth?code=<one-time>: Exchanges a one-time sign-in link for the session cookie, then redirects to /.
endpoints.POST /rpc: JSON-RPC 2.0 (single or batch). Requires the session cookie, Origin = this server, X-Striart: 1, Content-Type: application/json.
endpoints.GET /events: Server-Sent Events: "state.changed" and "control.notice", data = the JSON-RPC notification, id = seq. A slow client is disconnected and reconnects (the state is idempotent).

methods.name: control.initialize
methods.summary: Handshake: negotiate the protocol version, list methods and notifications.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: This OpenRPC document (methods, parameters, results, notifications, schemas).

methods.name: state.get
methods.summary: Full state: agents, queue, tickets, locks heatmap, history, main session, pending permissions, watcher, profiles.

methods.name: state.subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribe to state changes: the current state now, then `state.changed` and `control.notice` notifications. Over HTTP, use GET /events (Server-Sent Events) instead.

methods.name: state.unsubscribe
methods.summary: End a subscription.

methods.name: ticket.get
methods.summary: Read a conflict ticket in 3-way form (BASE / OURS / THEIRS / LLM attempt) with the Test Gate log.

methods.name: session.log
methods.summary: Tail of an autonomous session log (64 KB at most).

methods.name: doctor.run
methods.summary: Environment diagnosis (same report as `striart doctor --json`).

methods.name: task.run
methods.summary: Launch a task through the Router: a clone if no collision, else the queue. mode "autonomous" starts a supervised session in the background.

methods.name: agent.merge
methods.summary: Merge an agent's last commit (rebase, semantic merge on conflict, blocking Test Gate).

methods.name: agent.sync
methods.summary: Rebase one agent (or all of them) on the target branch.

methods.name: agent.stop
methods.summary: Stop an agent; refused while unmerged commits remain, unless force abandons them.

methods.name: queue.retry
methods.summary: Start the queued tasks that nothing blocks any more.

methods.name: reconcile.run
methods.summary: Neutralize dead sessions and unblock the queue (`striart reconcile`).

methods.name: staging.promote
methods.summary: Promote staging to the main branch under the global Test Gate.

params.name: rollback
params.description: Undo the target branch to its previous head if the gate is red.

methods.name: merge.rollback
methods.summary: Undo the last Striart merge of the target branch.

methods.name: ticket.prepare
methods.summary: Seed `.resolved` files from the agent version (never overwrites a prepared resolution).

params.name: acceptTheirs
params.description: Protected paths whose `.resolved` may be seeded from the agent version (explicit human decision; protected paths are otherwise never seeded).

methods.name: ticket.apply
methods.summary: Replay the ticket merge with the prepared resolutions, under the main lock and the Test Gate.

methods.name: ticket.close
methods.summary: Mark a ticket resolved by hand (no Test Gate) — human plane only.

methods.name: permission.answer
methods.summary: Arbitrate a semi-autonomous permission request with one of the options the agent proposed — human plane only.

methods.name: review.list
methods.summary: List the human review requests (most recent first), with "alive" = the waiting orchestrator still lives.

methods.name: review.answer
methods.summary: Give the verdict of a PENDING human review (approve, request-changes, reject, with a summary and structured remarks) — human plane only. The verdict is validated like an agent verdict; it only proposes: the merge still passes the Test Gate. Answered once; an expired or abandoned request is refused (REVIEW_NOT_PENDING).

methods.name: orchestration.state
methods.summary: Runs and groups of the orchestrated modes (review, team, pipeline, race) and the human reviews.

methods.name: elicitation.answer
methods.summary: Answer an agent's structured question (accept with content validated against its requestedSchema, decline, cancel) — human plane only. Invalid content keeps the request open.

methods.name: mainSession.release
methods.summary: Release the main repository session (`striart lock --stop`) — human plane only.

methods.name: semantic.unlock
methods.summary: Leave manual mode: re-enable the semantic merge (`striart resolve --unlock`).

methods.name: clones.clean
methods.summary: Delete the clones of stopped agents with nothing pending (never all/force: the cleanClones guards keep the last word).

methods.name: workspace.prune
methods.summary: Prune idle stopped clones and resolved tickets (config retention).

methods.name: workspace.gc
methods.summary: Idle GC sweep: detect idle agents, warn, and (action close or `close: true`, after the warning and grace period) cleanly close their SESSIONS. The clone and its work are always kept; no merge, no deletion. Human plane only.

x-notifications.name: state.changed
x-notifications.summary: The state changed (disk, agent refs, an action). Idempotent: render the latest revision. Over HTTP: SSE event "state.changed".

x-notifications.name: control.notice
x-notifications.summary: Human-readable event (merge done, gate red, autonomous session end). Over HTTP: SSE event "control.notice".

AgentName.description: Agent name: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, "-" or "_", 64 characters at most (same rule as the CLI).

TicketId.description: Conflict ticket id (its folder name under .striart/conflicts/).

ElicitationId.description: Id of a pending elicitation (structured question of an ACP agent).

ReviewId.description: Id of a human review request (.striart/reviews/<id>.json).

ReviewVerdictValue.description: Verdict of a review: approve, request-changes or reject.

ReviewSummary.description: Free-text summary of the verdict (neutralised and bounded by the domain).

ReviewCommentsInput.description: Structured remarks (50 at most). Paths are relative to the project and checked by the domain.

PermissionId.description: Id of a pending semi-autonomous permission request.

PermissionOptionId.description: One of the optionId values the agent proposed for this request.

Prompt.description: Task prompt — data, never code: passed to the agent as one argv element.

ErrorKind.description: usage = invalid input (CLI exit 2); refusal = a Striart guard said no (exit 3); failure = execution failed, may be transient (exit 1).

Outcome.description: Outcome of an operation that returned a result (the CLI maps it to exit 0/3/1).

hint.description: Next action, ideally an exact command.

details.description: Identifiers only (agent, ticket, path, PID) — secrets are redacted.

Document.description: Machine document: `striart <command> --json` on stdout, and the `result` (or `error.data`) of every Striart Control Protocol call.

command.description: CLI command name, or protocol method name.

RouterDetails.description: Router detail at launch (additive, informative: no decision depends on it). `serialized` tells why the task was serialized behind every active agent (sentinel `**`); `shared` lists bookkeeping files left out of collision detection (`tokens.router.sharedFiles`). Lists are bounded (`counts` holds the real totals); the raw model output never appears.

ObservedOverlap.description: A file REALLY touched (committed work, diff against the agent base) by two agents (`kind: agents`, only files the Router had not predicted for both) or by an agent while the target branch also advanced it (`kind: target`). Observed at runtime, independent of any prediction. `files` is bounded; `fileCount` is the real total.

key.description: Stable id of the signal (kind, agents, file set).

OverlapReport.description: Runtime overlap net (additive). Read-only: git diffs between COMMITS, never a worktree. `coverage.uncommitted` is always false: uncommitted edits are NOT seen. `cost.gitCalls` is bounded by `cost.budget` per observation; agents beyond the budget are listed in `deferred`, agents whose git facts could not be read in `errors` (stable reason only, never a git message). When the observation itself fails the value is `{unavailable: true, reason}`.

IdleAgent.description: Idle-GC verdict for one agent (additive). `state`: active (at least one fresh signal, or a signal that could not be read — fail closed), idle (EVERY signal is older than the threshold) or protected (a guard: pending human request, open ticket, orchestration plan, merge in progress, main-repo session, removal, exclusion). `session`: live process / ended (clone kept) / never launched. `closable` is true only when the warning, the grace period, the threshold and the authorization are all met.

IdleStatus.description: Idle GC (additive, read-only): a dry-run classification of every agent plus the date of the last real sweep. When it cannot be computed the value is `{available: false, reason}`.

status.description: REMOVING: the clone is being deleted (`removing` in the registry) — never shown as active or broken.

sizesComputedAt.description: When `sizeBytes` was measured (ISO 8601). Sizes are cached (at most 5 minutes old, refreshed sooner when the clone changes); activity and session state are never cached.

CorruptTicket.description: A ticket whose ticket.json is unreadable or missing, listed instead of silently ignored. Its business fields are unknown (null); it can only be closed (ticket.close) — ticket.get / ticket.prepare / ticket.apply refuse it with TICKET_CORRUPT.

TicketEntry.description: An entry of a ticket list: a readable Ticket, or a CorruptTicket (status "CORRUPT").

HumanReview.description: A human review request. Untrusted text (diffstat, verdict summary and remarks come from git and agents): display as text only. "alive" = the orchestrator process waiting for the verdict still lives.

OrchestrationStateData.description: Runs and groups of the orchestrated modes (alive computed) plus the human reviews.

TicketDetail.description: Full 3-way view of a ticket: BASE / OURS / THEIRS / LLM attempt per file.

ElicitationRequest.description: Structured question of an ACP agent, routed to the human. `message`, `url` and `requestedSchema` come from the agent: UNTRUSTED content — display as text, never interpret; a `url` is shown, never opened automatically.

instanceId.description: Random id of the serving instance: a change means a restart.

revision.description: Monotonic per instance: a client keeps the highest revision it rendered and ignores older ones.

StatusData.description: Data of `striart status --json` (same objects as ControlState).

Timings.description: Durations per phase of the operation, in milliseconds (monotonic clock). Every phase is always present (0 when it does not apply); `lockHeld` is the time the main lock was HELD, `total` the whole call. Additive field: clients ignore phases they do not know.

error.description: French text of the core (kept for compatibility); `errorCode` is the contract.

errorCode.description: Stable code of the semantic merge failure (e.g. SEMANTIC_MERGE_FAILED, TOKEN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED).

errorDetails.description: Public details of that failure (identifiers only: causeCode, provider, status…).

TaskRunData.description: Attended: same shape as `striart run --json` (no terminal is opened by the protocol: `session` is null). Autonomous: the session runs in the background of the serving process; its end is reported by `control.notice`.
